content.title: Speaking Test 14 — Friends
content.description: The full three-part interview: your free time in Part 1, a long turn on “Describe an old friend you got back in touch with”, then a discussion of friendship and social contact today.

prompts.promptHtml:
Let's talk about your free time.

What do you usually do at the weekend? [Why?]
Do you prefer to spend your free time alone or with other people? [Why?]
Has the way you spend your free time changed in recent years? [Why/Why not?]
Is there a hobby you would like to take up? [Why?]
Describe an old friend you got back in touch with.
bulletsHtml: how you got back in touch
and explain how you felt about seeing them again

prompts.promptHtml:
Let's consider friendship.

Why do people lose touch with friends as they get older?
Do you think it is possible to have a close friendship online?
How important is it to have friends of different ages?

Let's consider social contact today.

Are people in your country as sociable as they used to be?
What effect do social media sites have on real friendships?
Do you think people today are lonelier than in the past?
